title: Flash-dLLM: IO-Aware KV Caching and Parallel Decoding for Fast, Memory-Efficient Diffusion LLMs
selection_reason: Flash-dLLM identifies GPU memory I/O as a KV-cache bottleneck, introduces a fused cache kernel plus parallel draft-and-verify decoding, and reports 5.1x–11.0x speedups over the strongest cited baseline.
